policy: Primary sources support specific definitions and methods; project derivations are presented in full and remain scoped to their declared finite measure. No exhaustive literature claim.

sources.title: NIST DLMF 10.32.2: modified Bessel integral representation
sources.reading_depth: Read the displayed general-nu integral and its Re nu > -1/2 condition on the official source page; specialize to nu=1.
sources.supports: Normalization Z0(h)=2I1(h)/h for normalized SU(2) Haar x marginal.
sources.limitations: Does not certify the two-loop numerical quadrature or supply a mass gap.

sources.title: NIST DLMF 10.29: modified Bessel recurrences and derivatives
sources.reading_depth: Read the official recurrence/derivative section and used the I1-I3=4I2/h specialization.
sources.supports: u=I2/I1 and the cancellation-safe r=I3/(h² I1) representation.
sources.limitations: The conditional vector-moment derivation and positivity scope are established in the project text.

sources.title: Bootstrap for Finite N Lattice Yang-Mills Theory
sources.reading_depth: Read introduction/main results, SU(2) trace identity and normalization notes, hierarchy section, and one-matrix normalization formulas. Did not audit every loop equation, numerical bound or the full paper.
sources.supports: Finite-N trace reduction retains loop geometry and a loop-length hierarchy; contextual connection to compact moment work.
sources.limitations: No imported proof of the present mixed-loop covariance or continuum mass gap; the present action deformation is declared separately.

sources.title: SciPy official reference: scipy.special.ive
sources.reading_depth: Read scaled modified-Bessel function definition, parameters and numerical notes.
sources.supports: Exponentially scaled Bessels used for moderate strong conditional fields.
sources.limitations: Floating special functions are not certified intervals; installed version is bound in results.json.

sources.title: SciPy official reference: roots_jacobi
sources.reading_depth: Read quadrature weight definition and parameter conditions.
sources.supports: Gauss-Jacobi weights with alpha=beta=1/2 match the Haar marginal.
sources.limitations: The integrand is not a finite-degree polynomial; node refinement is a diagnostic rather than an exact quadrature theorem for this calculation.
